Personality: Numerius Decimius, a prominent figure of the Pentri, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Numerius Decimius owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Pentri. Historical Record: A noble of Bovianum, from the first family of the Pentri, rich and loyal to Rome, who can raise thousands of Samnites whenever Rome calls on him. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
